mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
